description: EPLFromClauseMethodVariable differential chain over variable-sampled method sources: constant-variable replays EPLFromClauseMethodConstantVariable (ordinal 0) where the preconfigured constant variable MyConstantServiceVariable supplies the fetchABean(intPrimitive) join source returning ids _<int>_ (_10_ then _20_); nonconstant-soda-true (ordinal 1) and nonconstant-soda-false (ordinal 2) replay EPLFromClauseMethodNonConstantVariable{soda=true} and {soda=false} with byte-identical steps and records, where the on-set statement mutates the MyNonConstantServiceVariable POJO postfix between SupportBean joins so fetchABean samples the variable's current value per invocation (_10_postfix, _20_newpostfix, _30_postfix; all three SupportBean sends use theString E1 verbatim per the suite quirk), with soda-true compiled through eplToModel plus a toEPL round-trip guard and soda-false compiled from text; context-variable (ordinal 3) replays EPLFromClauseMethodContextVariable with two overlapping MyContext partitions initiated by SupportBean_S0, a per-partition variable var seeded per partition by MyNonConstantServiceVariableFactory.make() with postfix context_postfix, sampled by the context-typed method join and mutated per partition by the on SupportBean_S2 set var.postfix statement (_1_context_postfix, _2_context_postfix, then _1_a and _2_b); map-and-oa (ordinal 4) replays EPLFromClauseMethodVariableMapAndOA as two triggerless deploy/iterate/undeploy cycles whose Map and ObjectArray method sources (MyMethodHandlerMap.getMapData with instance metadata, MyMethodHandlerOA.getOAData with static metadata) are observed under iterator snapshot as the single row field1=a,field2=b. The suite's sixth execution EPLFromClauseMethodVariableInvalid is compile-only and excluded under the invalidity policy, and the two trailing invalid compiles inside EPLFromClauseMethodContextVariable are likewise excluded from this chain and covered by Go-side Build-rejection tests, so the pinned differential scope is the listener and snapshot observables only.
